title: LLM constructs the ED model through MCP tool calls
description: Recorded session. Each step shows the LLM's utterance, the MCP tool call it issued, and the response from the simpy-mcp server. The server runs in your browser via Pyodide, so the responses are real.

steps.utterance: I have the brief in front of me. Three resource pools (triage, imaging, beds) plus a small lab. Let me define the resources first, smallest pool first.
Imaging is a single high-cost station; one machine.
Beds: four inpatient slots per the brief.
Now the arrival process. The brief gave a 12-minute mean inter-arrival from the input-modelling step.
Triage is short — exponential with mean 5 minutes.
Imaging is the bottleneck — exponential mean 15 minutes per case.
Bed length-of-stay is heavy-tailed, so log-normal with the parameters from input modelling.
Now wire the producers to the consumers. Arrivals feed triage.
Triage routes to imaging or directly to admit; we'll let the server pick uniformly between the two consumers it sees.
And triage to admit as the alternate route.
Imaging always feeds into admit when it finishes.
Construction complete. Five replications over an 8-hour shift, fixed seed.
Pulling the per-resource KPIs grouped by pool.
